#: Authored template variables, read beside reporters-db's (upstream/reporters-db/regexes.json) and written as it writes them: a row's regexes name these with $, and $reporter is the slot its own names fill. A variable here never shadows one there.

commonwealth.#: Commonwealth reports and legislation, as Canadian, UK and other Commonwealth writers cite them.

year_before.#: The year (or years) a writer puts before a volume, read before any citation by volume where the reading asks for it: '[2016] 1 SCR 631', '[1987] 36 CCC (3d) 417', '(1989), 49 NBR 144', '(1981), 401 U.S. 424', '(1943-1944), 57 Harv. L. Rev. 269', and with a period for its comma, '(1957). 21 W.W.R. 134'

issue.#: The issue a writer puts after a volume, read after any volume where the reading asks for it: '(1998) 43:2 McGill LJ 287'

report.year_volume#: A report whose volume is its year, in brackets (or, as some write it, parentheses): '[1932] AC 562'
report.law_reports#: A series of the Law Reports (1865-1875) cited with its volume after 'L.R.' and its own name after the volume: 'L.R. 1 Ex. 265'

neutral.bracketed#: A neutral citation with its year in brackets: '[2024] EWCA Civ 138'

statute.#: A revised or annual statute by year and chapter: 'RSC 1985, c C-46', 'SO 2002, c 30, Sched A', 'LRC 1985, ch C-46'

compiled.#: A compilation cited by chapter alone: 'CQLR c C-12', 'CCSM c C80', 'RRQ, c C-12, r 1'

regulation.#: A regulation by number and year: 'O Reg 213/91', 'Alta Reg 64/2036', 'SI 2000/1234'

consolidated.#: A consolidated regulation by chapter: 'CRC, c 870'

revised_regulation.#: A revised regulation by year and number: 'RRO 1990, Reg 194'

numbered_regulation.#: A Nunavut regulation by its registration number: 'CR Nu R-012-2004'
